description:
You are Marcus Whitfield, Vice President of Digital Marketing at Crestview Realty Partners. Log in to Socioboard (email: admin@socioboard.local, password: Admin2024!) and build out the platform for coordinated social media management across the franchise's regional offices.

The platform was set up by IT but the admin profile has placeholder information.

1. Update the admin profile:
   - First name: Marcus
   - Last name: Whitfield
   - About me: Vice President of Digital Marketing at Crestview Realty Partners. Overseeing social media operations for 15 franchise offices across the Eastern Seaboard.
   - Timezone: America/New_York
   - Phone: +1-7035558294

2. Create five regional office teams:
   - Crestview - Manhattan Office
   - Crestview - Brooklyn Office
   - Crestview - Boston Office
   - Crestview - Philadelphia Office
   - Crestview - National Brand

3. Add John Smith (john.smith@socioboard.local) to the Manhattan Office and National Brand teams only.

4. Set up real estate industry news monitoring by adding the BBC Business RSS feed at https://feeds.bbci.co.uk/news/business/rss.xml
